known_dataset_findings.finding: one S#### directory hosts up to five official samples (OK plus one session per defect code), so grouping by the directory merges distinct official samples
known_dataset_findings.consequence: the primary protocol groups by the official sample key; the D1-A first-pass serial grouping is archived as superseded and is not used

known_dataset_findings.finding: the released Real-IAD train and test splits share no official sample key
known_dataset_findings.consequence: no reservation of train samples is required and the historical 525-sample partition is reproducible

known_dataset_findings.finding: 53-93 S#### directories appear in both the train (OK session) and test (defect sessions) parts of a class
known_dataset_findings.consequence: documented as residual uncertainty about physical specimen identity; NOT counted as evaluation leakage

known_dataset_findings.finding: under the official sample key the historical V0.2 split has no train/test sample overlap
known_dataset_findings.consequence: the D1-A first-pass claim that V0.2 leaked physical samples was an artefact of the wrong identity rule; recorded serial-level coincidence is {'audiojack': 15, 'bottle_cap': 14, 'eraser': 15, 'plastic_plug': 18, 'switch': 24, 'rolled_strip_base': 25}

known_dataset_findings.finding: images from defective capture sessions are individually labelled OK when that camera view shows no defect
known_dataset_findings.consequence: image-level labels are never propagated across views; probes keep image-level truth

supersedes.reason: the first-pass parser treated the S#### directory as the physical object, which merges the OK and NG_<defect> official samples of one directory

claim_boundaries: D1-A-R1 reports metadata feasibility only; no anomaly-detection metric and no admission result is computed
primary grouping is the official Real-IAD sample key; the S#### serial analysis is a sensitivity diagnostic only
one image-level label is charged per official sample key per stream
physical manufactured-specimen identity is undocumented and remains a residual assumption
